The build succeeds. The UserStats component is complete.

## What I did

Completed app/UserStats.tsx to display the three requested statistics:

- Active users count — users.filter((user) => user.isActive).length
- Inactive users count — users.length - activeUsers
- Percentage of active users — (activeUsers / users.length)  100, with a guard against division by zero when users is empty

## Pattern followed

The codebase's existing convention for derived values is shown in app/page.tsx (lines 13–14): a plain const expression computed directly in the render body — no useMemo, no extra state, no effects. I matched that exactly, deriving all three values as local consts inside the component body.

## Verification

- tsc --noEmit — exit code 0, no errors
- npm run build — exit code 0, compiled successfully, static page generated

With the sample data in page.tsx (2 active of 3 users), the component renders Active Users: 2, Inactive Users: 1, Active Percentage: 66.666...%.
